coverage.beforeVersionBodyUnchanged: All 23 pages are unchanged before the version-difference heading after CRLF normalization. New sources and updated date are additive. Existing formulae, figures, explanations and deployment numbers have not been deleted or rewritten by this batch.
coverage.figureScope: Read the CP path, GLM two-node topology, KV-spec flow, quantization and KDA flow YAML captions/source scopes. New rc2 prose explicitly excludes applying old PCP×DCP slot formulae, 640-token blocks, 15-block request or old GLM memory totals to rc2. Diagram references are unchanged in every reviewed page.
limits: This is an independent delta and factual-condition review, not certification that every old paragraph across all four versions has been re-audited.
No browser playback or visual rendering inspection was performed by this reviewer; parent still owns actual browser acceptance.
No Ascend/NPU execution or performance/accuracy benchmark was performed.

findings.title: State the INT8-only LI C8 condition for fused Copy-SFA
findings.impact: The new rc2 paragraph permits LI C8 without identifying its serving dtype, then introduces fused_copy_sfa. Elsewhere rc2 LI C8 is derived for both fp8 and int8, so readers can combine fp8 with the new fused path even though that serving path is explicitly excluded by the guide.
findings.fix: When discussing fused_copy_sfa, say its LI C8 serving path requires attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype=int8 and does not support fp8. Add the guide's L160-L166 source. Keep the main SFA KV and device-resident indexer distinction.

findings.title: Extend source range to the separate draft-model checks
findings.impact: The factual statement about target and separate draft validation is correct, but the sole new platform source ends at L1711, immediately before the draft-validation function. A reader following only the new source cannot verify this part.
findings.fix: Add a focused source for _validate_draft_decode_context_parallel_config. In particular the draft GQA/MQA PCP+DCP equality call is L1741-L1744.

findings.title: Cover the experimental title and KPool rejection with direct rc2 sources
findings.impact: The new paragraph correctly says the model guide is experimental and KPool rejects PCP/DCP; the current new sources include neither the guide title at L1 nor the backend rejection at L450-L455.
findings.fix: Add these focused sources; two-node page likewise can cite the rejection directly rather than relying on a nearby page.

findings.title: Include the UCM registration name and module in the source range

findings.title: Add the implementation source named by the new summary
